scope: Worlds 1–3 of the original real-agent batch. Original run records are unchanged. Metrics quote existing post-session evaluations; scientific-process findings use acquired observations, tool traces and frozen candidates. World 3 numerical diagnostics do not import simulator truth or derive an alternative true model.

worlds.scientific_outcome: Submitted candidate has substantial prediction mismatch. Existing fit and validation observations already contradict adequacy; post-session evaluation is not the first evidence of failure.
diagnosis: All nonlinear candidates retained a central/radial structure, including polynomial, exponential and velocity-perturbed variants. Repeated within-family refits did not resolve systematic errors.

Residual record residual_30afd65ecaf2 shows substantial position errors and strong correlations. For probe_0008, position-coordinate maxima are about 0.144 and 0.113; correlations with time are about 0.975 and -0.967.

Candidate fits and validation tools returned finite, converged results with explicit errors. Parser failures for larger expressions are recorded as failures. No source or execution bug was found in the reviewed evidence.

acquired_only_numerical_check.method: Reintegrate the submitted frozen DSL candidate with the same acquired initial states and body estimates using DOP853 rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-14; compare to stored candidate predictions and acquired r_obs. No simulator truth import.
acquired_only_numerical_check.interpretation: Tighter integration changes candidate predictions by about 1e-8 while observed mismatch stays about 0.1. Candidate numerical integration error does not explain the discrepancy.

acquired_only_direction_check.reference: Use the submitted fitted center only, not any private true center. A radial force requires equal effective scalar multipliers in both nonzero displacement components.
acquired_only_direction_check.interpretation: These are finite-difference acceleration estimates, so discretization bias remains a caveat. Nevertheless their direction mismatch motivates direct discrimination of the radial assumption instead of treating it as established. No alternative true model is inferred here.

issues.finding: The candidate's shared radial assumption was not sufficiently tested, and the acquired-only tighter-integration check does not support integration error as an explanation of the observed 0.1 mismatch.

proposed_generic_prompt_guardrails: 中心力、旋转对称、各向同性、坐标分量独立及作用源位置都属于待检验假设，不能由轨迹看似围绕某点直接认定。同一结构族反复拟合后仍在新轨迹上出现明显、系统性的偏差，应先设计能检验这些共同假设的对照实验，比较结构不同的候选，而不是仅追加同类高阶项、改初值或扩大训练集。拟合收敛不是模型成立；保留与假设矛盾的证据，无法解释时如实报告候选未充分验证。
严格区分证据与工具状态：解析失败、超时或未执行的候选未受到科学检验；不同训练集上的拟合误差不能直接作为同条件优劣比较。数值积分或差分误差须有相应尺度或收敛证据，不能用来解释任意模型偏差。相关性、范围、最大值等只引用实际取得的统计或明确可复核的计算；预览不能代表完整数据。每条验证结论核对其 law_id 与训练、验证角色，不把旧版本或开发数据的结论移到最终版本。
limits: This review does not establish unique physical mechanisms or a universal success threshold.
The five-world batch is still running when this Worlds 1–3 review is written; no prompt was changed by this reviewer.
